Blacklick Valley School District records 90.6% four-year graduation rate in 2024-25
J. W. Hiller
Blacklick Valley School District in Cambria County reported a four-year cohort graduation rate of 90.6% for the 2024-25 school year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Education.
A total of 48 students graduated on time out of a cohort of 53, representing those who completed high school within four years.
The rate was 90% in the 2023-24 school year and rose 0.6 percentage points from the prior year.
Pennsylvania's four-year cohort graduation rate measures the percentage of students in a cohort who graduate within four years. These stories use the graduation rate, graduate count and cohort count the Pennsylvania Department of Education reports for the school district itself; they are not aggregated from individual schools. Suppressed or unavailable values are not converted into exact figures and are not used for exact comparisons, calculations or rankings.
Pennsylvania's four-year high school graduation rate reached 88% in the 2024-25 school year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Education. The rate increased from 87.6% in 2023-24 and 87% in 2022-23, marking the third consecutive year of improvement.

| 2019-20 | 81.6% |

| 2021-22 | 81.8% |
| 2022-23 | 78.9% |
| 2023-24 | 90% |
| 2024-25 | 90.6% |
Information in this article comes from the Pennsylvania Department of Education's high school graduation reports.
